title: Horizon R7 original-reference review
scope: Fresh visual audit of all 100 original compressed reference images for the original MOTOBOUND Festival/Solvane implementation. Feature implementation and executable validation are reported separately; this document does not claim recreation of every scene or commercial visual parity.

input_archive.name: Forza-Horizon-6-Reference-Pack-Under-30MB.zip
input_archive.origin: Existing user-provided reference pack recovered from ChatGPT Library; no substitute images fetched.

provenance.source_authority: URLs and original-source hashes retained from the supplied archive manifest; original full-resolution bytes and source-site claims were not independently re-downloaded or verified.
provenance.copyright_holder_as_recorded_in_manifest: Microsoft / Xbox Game Studios / Playground Games
provenance.repository_image_policy: Reference images remain review inputs outside the repository; no reference screenshot, brand artwork or licensed mesh is included in this change. Original rendered game screenshots may be retained as implementation evidence.

inspection_method.layout: Two columns by five rows with original numeric ID and category beneath every image. All ten sheets were opened with view_image at original detail.
inspection_method.full_resolution_method: The nine explicitly listed source JPGs were additionally opened directly with view_image at original detail.
inspection_method.limits: Contact sheets establish scene-level visual cues, not every small surface detail. Still images do not establish handling, aerodynamic forces, interactive behavior, calibrated luminance or human fun. A source hash check is distinct from visual inspection.

focus.facade-room-depth: Distinct ceiling/wall/floor or shelf layers visible behind current facade openings, stable room variation, dark frames and intentionally opaque bays.
focus.vehicle-glazing: Existing cabin or mechanical forms remain visible through a tinted reflective layer with an opaque perimeter; separate fine construction details when supported.
focus.driving-feedback-context: Competitor separation and concise live objectives inform presentation; aerodynamic integration and passing rewards need actual simulation tests.
